h:
我用这个工作流程通过 ComfyUI 将元数据保存到我的图像中。它需要一些自定义节点，包括 ComfyUI Essentials 和我自己的 Flux Prompt Saver 节点。

如果节点在图表中显示为红色，则表示您没有安装自定义节点。请查看 ComfyUI Manager，了解管理自定义节点安装的最佳方法。

请注意，此节点确实需要您手动选择检查点，并且不会捕获其他网络 (LoRA)。它捕获提示和基本信息，如采样器、步骤、种子、大小等。这利用了 Essentials 中的 Flux Sampler 参数节点，取代了标准 Ksampler 或 SamplerCustomAdvanced。

请随意在评论中留下问题，但是诸如“它不起作用”之类的评论没有建设性，也没有给我足够的信息来帮助您解决问题。我强烈建议您加入我的 Discordhttps://thebulge.xyz

o.en:
This workflow is what I use to save metadata to my images with ComfyUI. It requires a few custom nodes, including ComfyUI Essentials and my own Flux Prompt Saver node.

If the nodes appear red in the graph, it means you do not have the custom nodes installed. Please check out ComfyUI Manager for the best way to manage custom node installation.

Note that this node does require you to manually select the checkpoint and will not capture additional networks (LoRAs). It captures the prompt and basic information like the sampler, steps, seed, size, etc. This takes advantage of the Flux Sampler Parameters node from Essentials which replaces the standard Ksampler or SamplerCustomAdvanced.

Please feel free to leave questions in the comments, but comments like "it doesn't work" are not constructive and don't give me enough information to help you troubleshoot. I highly recommend you instead join my Discord athttps://thebulge.xyz
